nodes.label: Ask Model Media Replies
nodes.rationale: Waits for complete image or video generation and exposes copy/save/open controls rather than returning only an incomplete status or URL.

nodes.label: Ask Model
nodes.rationale: The question is transcribed by the transcription model but answered by a separately selected model in its own hidden window.

nodes.label: Auto Clean Dictation
nodes.rationale: Uses an independent hidden model window so cleaning and commands do not wait on the transcription window.

nodes.label: Concurrent Recording Queue
nodes.rationale: Uses two preloaded transcription pages, preserves recording order, and delays ready results while the user is speaking.

nodes.label: Audio Privacy Boundary
nodes.rationale: EchoType does not record audio; the selected provider page captures microphone audio and the application only reads resulting text.

nodes.label: Targeted Paste
nodes.rationale: Remembers the original window, focused control, and virtual desktop at key-down, restores them before Ctrl+V, and leaves text on the clipboard if the target is unavailable.

nodes.label: Web-based Voice Dictation
nodes.rationale: Uses the logged-in web sessions of ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude, avoiding API keys and per-use cost.
